slug: 2024-03-15 Undersea cables for Africa's internet retrace history and leave digital gaps as they connect continents

facts.fact: The Conversation Africa (Jess Auerbach Jahajeeah, 2024-03-15) states that in Liberia and Sierra Leone only one fibre optic cable comes into the country, so internet traffic stops when it breaks; Liberia was among the countries worst hit by the 14 March 2024 cable failures. The cable is not named and the date is the article's.
